Indian stock markets show mixed performance amid global cues

Indian stock markets experienced fluctuations, with the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty showing varied movements across different trading days. On some days, the Sensex and Nifty closed higher, driven by buying in blue-chip stocks and foreign fund inflows, particularly in IT firms. However, on other occasions, markets traded flat or pared gains, with mid and small-cap indices faltering. Global factors, including US economic data, Federal Reserve policy on interest rates, and Middle East tensions, influenced investor sentiment.
